entries.title: Ezekiel 24:1
segments: ¶Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth [day] of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:2
segments: "Son of man, write down the name of the day, this very day-the king of Babylon started his siege against Jerusalem this very day.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:3
segments: "And utter a parable to the rebellious house, and say to them, 'Thus says the Lord GOD: "Put on a pot, set [it] on, And also pour water into it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:4
segments: Gather pieces [of meat] in it, Every good piece, The thigh and the shoulder. Fill [it] with choice cuts;

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:5
segments: Take the choice of the flock. Also pile [fuel] bones under it, Make it boil well, And let the cuts simmer in it."

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:6
segments: 'Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Woe to the bloody city, To the pot whose scum [is] in it, And whose scum is not gone from it! Bring it out piece by piece, On which no lot has fallen.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:7
segments: For her blood is in her midst; She set it on top of a rock; She did not pour it on the ground, To cover it with dust.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:8
segments: That it may raise up fury and take vengeance, I have set her blood on top of a rock, That it may not be covered."

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:9
segments: 'Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Woe to the bloody city! I too will make the pyre great.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:10
segments: Heap on the wood, Kindle the fire; Cook the meat well, Mix in the spices, And let the cuts be burned up.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:11
segments: "Then set the pot empty on the coals, That it may become hot and its bronze may burn, [That] its filthiness may be melted in it, [That] its scum may be consumed.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:12
segments: She has grown weary with lies, And her great scum has not gone from her. [Let] her scum [be] in the fire!

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:13
segments: In your filthiness [is] lewdness. Because I have cleansed you, and you were not cleansed, You will not be cleansed of your filthiness anymore, Till I have caused My fury to rest upon you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:14
segments: I, the LORD, have spoken [it]; It shall come to pass, and I will do [it]; I will not hold back, Nor will I spare, Nor will I relent; According to your ways And according to your deeds They will judge you," Says the Lord GOD.'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:15
segments: ¶Also the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:16
segments: "Son of man, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, nor shall your tears run down.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:17
segments: "Sigh in silence, make no mourning for the dead; bind your turban on your head, and put your sandals on your feet; do not cover [your] lips, and do not eat man's bread [of sorrow]."

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:18
segments: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died; and the next morning I did as I was commanded.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:19
segments: And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these [things signify] to us, that you behave so?"

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:20
segments: Then I answered them, "The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:21
segments: 'Speak to the house of Israel, "Thus says the Lord GOD: 'Behold, I will profane My sanctuary, your arrogant boast, the desire of your eyes, the delight of your soul; and your sons and daughters whom you left behind shall fall by the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:22
segments: 'And you shall do as I have done; you shall not cover [your] lips nor eat man's bread [of sorrow].

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:23
segments: 'Your turbans shall be on your heads and your sandals on your feet; you shall neither mourn nor weep, but you shall pine away in your iniquities and mourn with one another.

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:24
segments: 'Thus Ezekiel is a sign to you; according to all that he has done you shall do; and when this comes, you shall know that I [am] the Lord GOD.'"

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:25
segments: 'And you, son of man-[will it] not [be] in the day when I take from them their stronghold, their joy and their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which they set their minds, their sons and their daughters:

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:26
segments: 'on that day one who escapes will come to you to let [you] hear [it] with [your] ears;

entries.title: Ezekiel 24:27
segments: 'on that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped; you shall speak and no longer be mute. Thus you will be a sign to them, and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.'"
